usedFor: Brevo holds your contact lists, and Swiftype indexes a document through “Create Document” when “Contact Added To List” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Added To List” in Brevo, then “Create Document” in Swiftype
bestTemplate.why: A contact joining a list is pushed to the Swiftype index right away, since the trigger is a hook.

watchOut: “Create Document” adds a document each run, so a contact moved between lists twice would be indexed twice.
